title: Senior Manager - Operations
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Ensure the day-to-day operations of the facility(s) or campus, including janitorial, life-safety, engineering, site services, and general maintenance are implemented and carried out in a manner consistent with C&W policies and client directives. Ensure all contracts are reviewed on a regular basis and are bid out as required and confirm invoices match contract pricing 
• Supervise all maintenance programs relating to the interior and exterior conditions and appearance of the properties
• Under the direction of the Facility Manager, respond promptly to requests for building maintenance, repairs, cleaning needs, etc. from building occupants and for the implementation of ongoing contract programs to address and resolve needs and problems
• Compile information necessary to ensure all site-specific documentation and reports are completed accurately and on time, including (and as applicable): Property Information Book, Site Operating Manual, Emergency Procedures Manual, IIPP Manual, Local Code Compliance Log, ADA Compliance Log, OSHA Log, Safety Meeting Log, Elevator Logs, Janitorial Log, Purchase Order Log, Vendor Certificates of Insurance, As-built Drawings, IIPP Manual, Paid Invoices File, General Files, Contract Files, Annual Property Conditions and Year- end 
 Performance Report and other reports and documentation as required 
• Prepares budgets, financial reports (monthly and quarterly), contracts, expenditures and purchase orders related to the facility(s) or complex as directed
• Assist in providing information and reports necessary for the development of capital budgets for the facility. This includes contributions towards a five-year plan of maintenance, facility improvement, and cost reduction initiatives
• Collect, analyze and prepare reports of such statistical data as may be required to provide accurate and current assessment of facility management objectives
• Expected to be thoroughly familiar with the management contract, vendor agreements, and other building/facility contracts and all requirements contained therein 
• Monitor and ensure that tenants and vendors comply with insurance requirements and coordinate all claims as required
• Proactively inspect the facility, systems, rooms, common areas, etc. and report back any findings or issues to the Facility Manager
 KEY COMPETENCIES 
1. Communication Proficiency (oral and written)
2. Technical Proficiency
3. Problem Solving/Analysis
4. Leadership
5. Teamwork Orientation
6. Relationship Management
7. Financial Management
IMPORTANT EDUCATION 
• Associates degree in facilities management, building, business or other related field required
• Bachelors degree preferred
 IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE 
• Experience in maintenance, construction, engineering and all facets of property operation and building management preferred
• CMMS/Work Order Management experience is preferred
ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS
• Certified Facility Manager (CFM), International Facilities Management Association (IFMA), Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) industry certifications recommended; other Engineering, Business or technical training or certifications a plus
• Ability to read and understand construction specifications and blueprints
• Proficient in understanding management agreements and contract language
• Skilled in Building Management Systems maintenance and monitoring 
• Excellent computer and systems knowledge; Strong literacy in Microsoft Office Suite (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Strong discipline of financial management including financial tracking, budgeting and forecasting
• Knowledge of Financial Systems (Yardi a plus)
 WORK ENVIRONMENT 
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. May be required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.
 PHYSICAL DEMANDS 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with others and exchange accurate information; operate a computer and other office productivity machinery; move about the workplace; remain in a stationary position for 50-75% of the time; and extend hands and arms in any direction.
 OTHER DUTIES
 This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.
Note: This job description includes the core responsibilities for C&W. These duties may have slight modifications based on the regional location.

title: Team Lead
description:
Position: Team Leader Department: Operations Reports to: Venue Admin 

 Job Overview: As a Team Leader at Bounce Inc., you will play a pivotal role in leading and motivating a team of enthusiastic individuals within our trampoline park and entertainment facility. You will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of daily activities, maintaining a high level of customer service, and fostering a positive and engaging environment for both guests and team members. The Team Leader will report directly to the Park Manager and collaborate closely with other team leaders to achieve business objectives. 


 KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Preparation of the run sheet as per the rostered offs and send it to Venue Administrator for his review Coordinating with DJ vendor for important days in the venue i.e. Tuesday, Sunday and Public Holidays Ensuring that the Housekeeping Team is following their regular run sheet and completing the tasks and duties regularly Count of Bands, Socks, reception cash float, lost and found register is to be maintained at reception Customer Lockers to be checked after closing and beginning of the shift. Any issues to be addressed to Maintenance department for rectification Customer, staff and Directors washrooms to be kept clean and hygienic at all times Daily Huddle and grooming check of the venue staff to be done Mall Rounds & Mall Performances to be done as per the requirement Maintaining the RIO reports as per the standard Handling the injuries and ensuring the best customer safety standards Preparing daily reports and submitting to the reporting manager on timely basis 

 Values & Behaviours Lead by example by living BOUNCE Values on a day-to-day basis and encourage and help all Hosts to do the same Regularly step into the shoes of a Host to ensure Team Leader presence is felt on the floor and front of house Positively influence and maintain the BOUNCE culture through direct and indirect action as needed Take every opportunity to promote the BOUNCE Vision, Values and Culture both internally and externally 

 People Management Lead, coach and supervise Hosts so that they are engaged and consistently delivering an exceptional experience Facilitate training and induction to ensure Hosts are able to achieve current role requirements Ensure Hosts follow specified systems and procedures and complete checklists fully and on time Effectively performance manage Hosts i.e. conduct one-on-ones, induction, conversations around availability and adhering to Bounce policies and procedures 

 Customer Experience & Delivery Facilitate a Free-Jumping Revolution culture! Welcome and serve customers in an efficient and friendly manner and provide a high level of product and service knowledge Actively promote suite of Bounce products and programs to customers Facilitate customer flow throughout the reception, Tuck Shop and party areas and deliver an exceptional customer experience Prepare F&B offers for group bookings (e.g. schools, parties, corporates) and ensure delivery is on time Proactively communicate upcoming bookings, programs, customer activity (e.g. Bounce Squad, group bookings) with team to assist in planning and coordination Check daily occupancy and liaise with Venue Management to ensure efficient coordination of organised groups such as schools, corporate or large group bookings Check rosters and ensure breaks are allocated based on customer activity. Ensure party rooms are clean, set-up and available based on customer numbers Manage customer issues and resolve promptly Forward all customer feedback regarding promotions, team members, customer experience and complaints to the Assistant Venue Manager to review Ensure the delivery of all programs and group experiences are to a high standard and as designed Safety Uphold Bounces Leaders in Safety status by maintaining a safe environment for all customers, team members and contractors with a focus on prevention and intervention Complete incident and injury reports in an accurate and timely manner Complete Tuck shop operating checklists and ensure that food safety standards are maintained Ensure First Aid and other equipment is regularly checked, maintained and stocked to ensure that safety standards are met Confidently provide groups with safety briefings and ensure that safety rules are enforced Ensure radio communication in place across all areas and that PA announcements are made hourly Communicate with Hosts to ensure that hourly rotations occur 

 Presentation & Cleanliness Ensure the reception, Tuck Shop and party areas are clean and well presented at all times Ensure all non-trampoline areas represent the brand and are set up for functional use Ensure the Venue Presentation checklist is adhered to at all times 

 Stock Management Follow systems for stock control, rotation and food storage Daily stock taking in kitchen Ensure that the presentation of food, beverage and merchandise is of a high standard Ensure safe food and beverage handling standards and quality is maintained Responsible for cash handling each day and preparing banking Maintaining the stock inventory of all operations related activities (For e.g., Bands, Socks, DB Balls, Outdoor Events Stock, all trampoline related material & HK Materials) 

 Repairs & Maintenance Complete equipment and maintenance audits and required checklists for all activity areas Ensure preventative maintenance is completed in a timely manner Ensure required repairs are made promptly using approved contractors

If you are a motivated leader with excellent communication skills and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Team Leader.

description:
Job Description Position: ISO Tank Depot Operations USA & Canada Designation: Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager / Manager
 Location: Ghatkopar West, Mumbai
 Work Mode: Hybrid
 Working Hours: EST Time Zone
 Department: ISO Tank Operations / Operations
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About SAR Transport Systems Pvt. Ltd. SAR Transport Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a multinational logistics and freight forwarding organization with a presence in 40+ countries , supported by a team of 800+ professionals across 24 offices in India, the USA, and Southeast Asia . With 21+ years of industry experience , SAR has established a strong presence in the IndiaUSA and IndiaCanada trade corridors and serves 50,000+ customers across various industries. We provide integrated logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing, transportation, and supply chain solutions. At SAR, we are driven by innovation, customer centricity, transparency, and operational excellence , enabling us to deliver reliable and customer-focused logistics solutions. 
 Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ISO Tank Depot Operations professional to manage and coordinate day-to-day ISO Tank depot activities across the USA and Canada . The role will involve coordinating with ISO Tank depots, customers, consignees, and internal teams to ensure timely tank availability, release, cleaning, MNR (Maintenance & Repair) , inspections, testing, documentation, and movement. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring pending depot activities, following up on tank-related repairs and requirements, reviewing depot charges, managing claims, and ensuring smooth ISO Tank operations while minimizing operational delays. Key Responsibilities ISO Tank Depot Coordination Coordinate with ISO Tank depots across the USA and Canada for tank availability, release status, positioning, and operational requirements. Maintain regular communication with depots to monitor the status of all assigned ISO Tanks. Follow up with depots to ensure timely completion of all pending tank-related activities. Coordinate with depots, customers, consignees, and internal teams to ensure smooth ISO Tank release and movement . Monitor depot turnaround timelines and proactively identify potential operational delays. ISO Tank Cleaning, MNR & Technical Activities Follow up with depots for pending ISO Tank cleaning, MNR (Maintenance & Repair), CC/PT, pressure testing, inspection, repair, and other tank-related activities . Coordinate with depots for special cleaning, kosher cleaning , and other customer-specific ISO Tank cleaning requirements. Follow up for repair estimates and obtain necessary approvals from concerned teams/customers. Monitor the progress of ISO Tank repair and maintenance activities until completion. Ensure that required inspection, testing, certification, and supporting documentation is received from the depot. Follow up on tanks pending release due to cleaning, repair, MNR, testing, or other technical requirements. Documentation & Depot Reports Follow up with depots for pending reports, photographs, estimates, invoices, inspection reports, repair details, and other supporting documents . Review depot documentation for completeness and coordinate with relevant teams for any discrepancies. Maintain accurate ISO Tank-wise and depot-wise records of ongoing and completed activities. Regularly update operational trackers and status reports for management and internal stakeholders. Depot Charges & Cost Coordination Review and coordinate depot-related charges associated with ISO Tank cleaning, storage, MNR, LOLO, repairs, inspections, testing, and other applicable activities . Coordinate with depots and internal teams to validate and resolve discrepancies in depot charges. Follow up for estimates and approvals related to ISO Tank repairs and maintenance. Monitor exceptional or additional depot costs and escalate them to the concerned team for approval/resolution. Damage, Heel & ISO Tank Claims Follow up on ISO Tank damage, heel, repair, cleaning, and other tank-related claims with consignees, depots, customers, and concerned parties. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to obtain supporting documents, photographs, estimates, and other evidence required for claim resolution. Monitor open claims and ensure timely follow-up until closure. Escalate unresolved or high-value claims to the concerned management/team. Import & Export Coordination Coordinate with the Import and Export teams for ISO Tank movement, release, positioning, availability, and operational requirements. Ensure timely communication regarding tank status and availability to support import/export planning. Coordinate with internal teams to avoid delays in tank movement and customer operations. Provide timely updates on tank availability, depot status, pending activities, and expected release dates. Reporting & Escalation Maintain and update depot-wise ISO Tank operational trackers and status reports . Prepare regular reports on pending cleaning, MNR, repair, testing, release, claims, and other depot activities. Identify delays, bottlenecks, and operational risks and proactively follow up for resolution. Escalate urgent ISO Tank depot issues, delayed activities, cost concerns, claims, and other critical matters to the concerned teams and management. Ensure timely closure of pending activities and maintain proper follow-up records. Stakeholder Management Develop and maintain effective working relationships with ISO Tank depots, customers, consignees, internal operations teams, Import/Export teams, and other stakeholders . Ensure clear and timely communication regarding ISO Tank requirements and operational status. Handle multiple depots and tank-related activities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and service quality. Support the team in ensuring smooth day-to-day ISO Tank operations across the USA and Canada . Required Skills & Competencies Experience in ISO Tank operations, tank container operations, depot operations, shipping, logistics, freight forwarding, or transportation . Good understanding of ISO Tank cleaning, MNR (Maintenance & Repair), CC/PT, pressure testing, inspection, repair, LOLO, storage, and depot processes . Strong knowledge of ISO Tank movement and release processes will be preferred. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with USA/Canada-based depots, customers, and stakeholders . Strong problem-solving and escalation management skills. Good attention to detail and ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Outlook, and operational tracking/reporting tools . Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned ISO Tank operations. Customer-focused approach with strong commitment to timelines and service quality. Willingness to work in EST time zone / US business hours . 
 Experience 
 Candidates with experience specifically in ISO Tank / Tank Container Operations, Tank Depots, Shipping Lines, NVOCC, Freight Forwarding, Logistics, or Transportation Operations will be preferred. 
 Key Performance Areas Timely ISO Tank release and availability Closure of pending MNR, cleaning, repair, CC/PT, and pressure-testing activities Effective coordination with USA & Canada ISO Tank depots Timely resolution of damage, heel, and tank-related claims Accurate monitoring of depot charges and estimates Timely completion of depot documentation and reports Minimizing operational delays and tank turnaround time Effective coordination with Import, Export, Customer, Depot, and internal teams

This is a senior, high-ownership individual contributor role: the person will be the single point of expertise for NetSuite across departments and geographies (India, Mexico and US) running all day-to-day administration, architecture, and system/master-data integration activities independently and without supervision. Beyond administration, this role is expected to shape how NetSuite is architected: designing workflows, process flows and SOPs, governing master data across systems, and owning integrations that keep NetSuite and connected platforms in sync.  Key Responsibilities Architecture, Workflow & Master Data Own the end-to-end architectural design of NetSuite workflows and business processes translating business requirements into scalable system architecture independently, without requiring supervision. Build architecture flow diagrams / workflows and SOPs, and manage and control them within NetSuite on an ongoing basis. Define and govern master data management (MDM) standards within NetSuite customers, vendors, items, chart of accounts and entities ensuring a single, consistent source of truth across systems. Design, own and manage system integrations between NetSuite and other business/master-data systems (ExpoSync, Power BI, RFID tools, and future platforms), ensuring data consistency and integrity across the landscape. Drive continuous improvement of ERP architecture and workflows in line with business growth and evolving process needs. Platform Administration & Support Serve as the primary in-house owner and administrator of the NetSuite instance, supporting ~150+ users across departments in India and the US. Manage user roles, permissions, and access across multiple departments and entities. Troubleshoot day-to-day issues raised by Sales, Finance, Operations, and other departments; resolve or triage tickets promptly. Build and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards, custom forms, and workflows (SuiteFlow). Write and maintain small-to-medium customizations using SuiteScript 2.0 (scripts, workflows, custom fields/records). Monitor data integrity, system performance, and adherence to internal controls. Support month-end/quarter-end processes from a systems standpoint, working closely with cross-functional teams. Own NetSuite release updates — review new features, test in sandbox, and roll out changes with minimal disruption. Create and maintain internal documentation and basic training material for end users. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination Operate as the sole in-house architectural and functional authority for NetSuite, exercising independent judgment on design decisions and managing all activities without day-to-day supervision. Act as the primary point of contact with the NetSuite System Integration (SI) partner — scoping change requests, reviewing solution design, and validating delivered work for larger projects, escalations, or advanced customizations. 
 Required Experience & Skills 8–10 years of hands-on NetSuite administration and architecture experience (not purely functional/consulting) — genuine, independent ownership of an instance end-to-end. Demonstrated ability to independently design NetSuite architecture, workflows and business process flows, translating requirements into scalable solutions with minimal oversight. Strong working knowledge of SuiteScript 2.0 and SuiteFlow, with a track record of building and maintaining custom scripts/workflows. Experience managing multi-entity / multi-subsidiary NetSuite environments (India, US and Mexico experience strongly preferred). Proven experience owning master data management (MDM) practices — data governance, standardization and de-duplication across entities and systems. Proven experience architecting and managing system integrations between NetSuite and third-party/master-data platforms (Power BI, RFID, custom applications such as ExpoSync). Solid understanding of core modules relevant to Exponents: Sales/CRM, Order Management, Finance/Accounting, Inventory (as applicable). title: Assistant Warehouse Operations Manager
description:
The Assistant Manager – Warehouse Operations will own end-to-end warehouse performance
across third-party partner coordination, order fulfilment, inventory accuracy, and
inbound/outbound governance. This role has direct ownership of critical warehousing OKRs.
The incumbent is expected to operate with a process-first, metric-driven, and ownership
mindset, ensuring accuracy, speed, and SLA adherence across all warehouse touchpoints.

Core Ownership (Direct Responsibility)
(Hands-on execution + outcome accountability) 
1. Order Fulfilment & SLA Adherence
• Own end-to-end coordination with 3PL/warehouse partners to ensure 99.9%+ SLA adherence
on order dispatch
• Track daily order release, picking, packing, and dispatch timelines; escalate and resolve
bottlenecks proactively
• Drive B2B order dispatch adherence — including cut-off compliance, priority routing, and
marketplace/channel SLA commitments
• Build and monitor dashboards for real-time fulfilment health; ensure data accuracy and
leadership readiness 
2. Inward & GRN Operations
• Own Inward TAT and GRN TAT — from ASN receipt to stock availability on WMS
• Ensure vendor shipments are received, counted, and GRN-ed within defined SLAs
• Identify and resolve inward discrepancies (quantity shortages, quality rejections, mismatch) in
coordination with vendors and warehouse teams
• Drive process improvements to reduce inward processing time and error rates 
3. RTO & RTV Operations
• Own RTO (Return to Origin) and RTV (Return to Vendor) putaway accuracy and TAT
• Ensure returned units are received, inspected, graded, and put away within defined timelines
• Drive coordination between logistics partners and the warehouse to close RTO loops without
inventory leakage
• Monitor RTV workflows for accurate vendor credit reconciliation and timely stock disposition

4. Inventory Management & Cycle Count
• Own monthly inventory variance tracking through systematic cycle counts
• Design and execute cycle count schedules across SKUs; ensure 100% coverage of high-velocity
and high-value inventory
• Investigate root causes of shrinkage, variances, and mismatch; drive corrective actions with
warehouse partners
• Maintain inventory accuracy benchmarks and publish monthly variance reports to leadership 
5. Systems & Integrations
• Act as SPOC for warehouse system integrations including:
• WMS such as Unicommerce / EasyEcom / Increff
• OMS such as Shopify / Magento
• Ensure configuration accuracy, escalate system issues, and coordinate with tech for resolution
• Drive WMS hygiene — location mapping, bin accuracy, cycle count workflows, and exception
handling

Oversight Responsibility
(Review, guide, unblock, and ensure outcomes) 
1. Warehouse Partner Governance
• Conduct performance reviews with 3PL partners (weekly/bi-weekly)
• Define improvement plans for underperforming partners; track SLA breach root causes
• Oversee adherence to SOPs for picking, packing, dispatch, and returns
• Monitor labour utilization, slot adherence, and dock scheduling at partner warehouses 
2. B2B Ops & Trade Fulfilment
• Oversee B2B order processing workflows including bulk dispatch, routing, and invoice
generation
• Track marketplace/channel order timelines and ensure no dispatch SLA breach
• Coordinate with sales and distribution teams on order priorities and stock availability 
3. Finance & Reconciliation
• Oversee 3PL billing verification and invoice reconciliation
• Track credit notes related to inventory shortages, GRN discrepancies, and return disputes
• Ensure quarterly ledger reconciliation with warehouse partners

Key Stakeholder Management
• Internal: Logistics, Customer Support, Finance, Sales & Distribution, Tech/Product
• External: 3PL/Warehouse partners, WMS/OMS vendors, Vendors/Suppliers

Success Metrics
• Order Fulfilment SLA adherence (target: 99.9%+)
• B2B dispatch adherence %
• Inward & GRN TAT vs. defined SLA
• RTO/RTV put away accuracy & TAT
• Monthly inventory variance % (cycle count)
• 3PL SLA breach rate
• Escalation resolution TAT

 Job Overview 
ICHIGO is seeking a hands-on, results-driven Operations Manager to oversee daily operations for its strawberry business. The role covers sourcing coordination, packaging, inventory, cold-chain logistics and order fulfilment, ensuring customers receive fresh, high-quality products on time.
The ideal candidate will have experience managing perishable products, coordinating vendors and teams, controlling costs and reducing wastage.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Daily Operations: Plan and manage product receipt, sorting, grading, packing and dispatch in line with demand and quality standards. Sourcing & Vendor Management: Coordinate with growers, suppliers, packaging vendors and logistics partners to ensure reliable supply and timely deliveries. Quality & Cold Chain: Monitor product freshness, handling, storage temperatures and transport conditions. Coordinate quality checks and resolve product issues. Inventory & Wastage Control: Maintain accurate stock records, batch traceability and expiry tracking. Follow first-expiry-first-out practices and investigate spoilage, damage and stock differences. Packaging & Order Fulfilment: Ensure packaging availability, correct labelling, packing accuracy and timely dispatch across retail, distributor and online channels. Cost & Budget Management: Track procurement, packaging, warehousing and delivery costs. Manage purchase orders, verify vendor invoices and identify savings without compromising quality. Sales & Marketing Coordination: Align stock availability and dispatch capacity with sales forecasts, promotions and seasonal demand. Team & Process Management: Supervise operational staff, establish clear procedures and train teams on hygiene, handling and safety. Reporting: Maintain operational dashboards covering fulfilment, inventory, wastage, quality issues and costs. Candidate Qualifications 
 Experience: 3-5 years in FMCG operations, with hands-on experience in fresh produce, food or other perishable products. Education: Bachelors degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Food Technology or a related field. Operational Knowledge: Experience in inventory management, vendor coordination, warehousing, cold-chain logistics and food safety practices. title: Client Business Advisor
description:
About The Plain Office The Plain Office provides bookkeeping, financial reporting, office support, and practical technology-enabled services to small businesses, initially focused on Amish and Old Order Mennonite business owners in the United States. We combine respectful personal service with capable international teams, sound business judgment, and modern AI-enabled systems. 
 Position summary The Client Business Advisor owns the successful delivery of services across a portfolio of small-business clients. You will take over after initial discovery, gather and organize the remaining details, translate needs into a service plan, coordinate the accounting team, review monthly financial output for reasonableness, ensure reports are delivered on time, resolve breakdowns, and identify additional ways we can help each client. This is not a traditional bookkeeping role. It requires ownership, judgment, communication, and the ability to understand what the numbers mean for a business owner. Reports to: President (US) and Head of International Business and Operations (India) 
 Key responsibilities Lead detailed onboarding and service handoff after the initial sales conversation. Coordinate recurring work across approximately four accounting professionals and, over time, a portfolio of roughly 40-50 standardized small-business clients. Ensure monthly close activities, reports, and client deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule. Review P&Ls, balance sheets, reconciliations, job-costing reports, and management information for anomalies and commercial reasonableness. Ask insightful questions, obtain missing information, and drive issues to resolution. Coordinate the Chartered Accountants involvement in technical reviews and higher-level client discussions. Communicate directly with U.S. clients by phone, Zoom, and written channels in clear, understandable English. Identify additional bookkeeping, reporting, office-support, staffing, process-improvement, and automation opportunities. Use Claude, ChatGPT, spreadsheets, and AI-assisted tools to improve analysis, reports, procedures, and workflows. Provide clear operational direction and feedback to assigned accounting team members. Improve systems when recurring problems appear and escalate material risks early. Serve clients with patience, respect, confidentiality, and practical judgment. 
 Required qualifications Bachelors or masters degree in accounting, commerce, finance, business, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Approximately 7+ years of relevant experience in accounting operations, controllership, outsourced finance, client advisory, professional services, business operations, or small-business leadership. Strong spoken and written English with the confidence to lead U.S. client conversations. Demonstrated ability to interpret financial statements and identify when results do not make business sense. Experience coordinating multiple people, deadlines, and client deliverables. High personal ownership, sound judgment, structured follow-up, and comfort addressing performance or quality issues. Working knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, cash versus accrual accounting, and job costing. Comfort using modern AI tools and spreadsheets to solve business problems. 
 Preferred qualifications CA, CMA, MBA, M.Com, CPA-track, or comparable finance/business qualification. Experience serving U.S., Canadian, U.K., or Australian clients. Experience managing outsourced accounting teams or a portfolio of small-business clients. Experience as a controller, finance manager, advisory manager, operations manager, or former business owner. Ability to build scalable processes and develop future advisors or team leads. Existing U.S. visa is helpful but not required. 
 What success looks like Clients are served proactively; reports are accurate, useful, and on time; problems are resolved before clients or senior leaders must intervene; team members understand their responsibilities; open items are followed through; systems improve; and valuable additional-service opportunities are consistently identified.

title: Associate - Administration & Accounts
description:
Job Description Associate - Administration & Accounts 
 About Primarch Skills Primarch Skills Pvt. Ltd. is a purpose-driven organization committed to enabling sustainable livelihoods through large-scale skill development and income generation initiatives. We work closely with government bodies and public sector institutions to design and deliver outcome-oriented programs that empower marginalized and underserved communities across India. With a strong focus on inclusivity, employability, and entrepreneurship, Primarch Skills implements end-to-end solutions from community mobilization and training delivery to placement, self-employment, and post-training support. Our programs are aligned with national and state skill development missions, ensuring compliance, transparency, and measurable impact. At Primarch Skills, we believe that skills are the foundation of economic dignity. By equipping beneficiaries with market-relevant competencies and livelihood opportunities, we strive to create long-term socio-economic transformation and contribute meaningfully to nation-building. 
 Position Details Position Title: Associate - Administration & Accounts Number of Positions: 01 Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Reporting To: Administration / Finance Manager Employment Type: Full-time, in-office Experience Required: 3-5 Years 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Bachelors Degree Candidates with a Bachelors Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or related disciplines may apply for this position. Masters Degree (Preferred/Advantageous) Candidates with a Masters Degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or related fields will be preferred. Candidates who have cleared or are pursuing CA Intermediate / CMA Intermediate will also be considered favourably. 
 Additional preference will be given to candidates possessing: Hands-on experience of day-to-day accounting in Tally Prime / Tally ERP 9. Working knowledge of GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and Professional Tax compliance. Exposure to billing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliation. Good command over MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS) and MS Office tools. Strong documentation and data management skills. Experience in development sector, NGO, skilling, or project-based organisations, including billing to government departments. 
 Relevant Work Experience Candidates with 1–3 years of progressive experience in accounts, bookkeeping, billing, GST filing, TDS filing, EPF and ESI compliance, or finance operations, along with exposure to office administration, are eligible to apply for this position. 
 Preference will be given to candidates with demonstrated experience in: Voucher entry, ledger maintenance, and bookkeeping in Tally. Preparation of GST-compliant invoices and maintenance of billing records. Vendor bill processing, payment scheduling, and vendor ledger reconciliation. Receivables tracking and payment follow-up with clients. Bank reconciliation and petty cash management. Preparation of GST and TDS returns and statutory payment challans. Month-end closing support and audit schedules. Office administration and procurement support. 
 Role Overview The Associate - Administration & Accounts will primarily support the accounts and finance function, with a smaller share of responsibility for office administration. The role covers bookkeeping in Tally, billing, payables, receivables, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance, and month-end reporting, across Primarch Skills and its sister concerns and subsidiaries, as assigned. 
 The role requires a detail-oriented individual with a sound understanding of accounting processes, strong coordination skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines accurately. The selected candidate will work closely with the finance, administration, HR, and programme teams to maintain accurate books of accounts, ensure timely billing and compliance, and support smooth day-to-day office operations. 
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 A. Accounts & Finance Bookkeeping & Tally Operations Record day-to-day accounting transactions in Tally Prime, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and proper classification. Pass payment, receipt, purchase, sales, journal, contra, debit note, and credit note vouchers. Create and maintain ledgers, groups, and cost centres for project-wise and entity-wise accounting. Record entries with proper narration and attach supporting documents to every voucher. Carry out periodic ledger scrutiny and rectify misclassified or duplicate entries. Billing & Invoicing Prepare and raise invoices to clients, government departments, and partner institutions in line with work orders, agreements, and project milestones. Prepare GST-compliant tax invoices and supporting annexures as per client or department formats. Generate e-invoices (IRN) and e-way bills where applicable. Maintain a billing register tracking work order value, amount billed, amount received, and balance to be billed. Coordinate with programme teams for milestone completion documents, attendance and outcome data required for billing claims. Accounts Payable Manage the end-to-end processing of vendor and service-provider bills. Verify vendor bills against purchase orders, work orders, and delivery or service confirmations. Book vendor invoices in Tally, with correct GST input and TDS deduction. Prepare weekly payment schedules for approval and process approved payments through net banking. Maintain vendor ledgers, reconcile balances, and respond to vendor queries. Maintain vendor master data, including PAN, GSTIN, bank details, and MSME status, and track MSME payment timelines. Accounts Receivable & Collections Track outstanding receivables and follow up for timely collection. Maintain customer-wise and project-wise receivable ageing. Follow up with clients and government departments for release of payments, including submission of any pending documents. Record receipts and reconcile TDS deducted by clients with Form 26AS / AIS. Track retention money, security deposits, and performance guarantees, and follow up on their release. Bank, Cash & Payment Reconciliation Ensure that bank and cash records are accurate and reconciled on time. Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements for all bank accounts. Manage petty cash, cash vouchers, and periodic cash verification. Maintain records of NEFT/RTGS transfers, cheques issued and received, and payment advices. GST Compliance Support monthly and annual GST compliance under the guidance of the finance team. Maintain sales and purchase registers for GST purposes. Prepare data for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B and support timely filing. Reconcile purchase register with GSTR-2A / 2B and track eligible Input Tax Credit. Support preparation of data for annual returns and GST notices or queries. TDS Compliance Ensure correct deduction, deposit, and reporting of TDS. Identify applicable TDS sections and rates on vendor, contractor, professional, and rent payments. Prepare monthly TDS payment challans within due dates. Support preparation and filing of quarterly TDS returns (24Q and 26Q) and issue of Form 16 / 16A. Reconcile TDS records with TRACES and resolve defaults or mismatches. Payroll Accounting & Statutory Dues Coordinate with the HR team on payroll-related accounting and statutory payments. Book monthly salary entries and reconcile payroll with HR records. Prepare and deposit EPF (ECR) and ESI challans and maintain contribution records. Process Maharashtra Professional Tax payments and returns. Process employee reimbursements, travel advances, and their settlements. Expense Management & Project Costing Track costs and expenses at project and entity level. Verify and process employee expense claims as per the organisation’s policy. Track project-wise expenditure against approved budgets and highlight variances. Support preparation of fund utilisation statements and utilisation certificates for government-funded projects. Month-End Closing & Financial MIS Support timely closing of books and preparation of financial reports. Book month-end accruals, provisions, and prepaid adjustments. Review trial balance and support preparation of monthly profit & loss and project-wise statements. Update Excel-based MIS, including receivables, payables, cash flow, billing, and expense trackers. Audit & Compliance Support Maintain records for internal audits, statutory audits, tax audits, and programme audits. Prepare audit schedules, ledger extracts, and supporting documents, and help resolve audit queries within agreed timelines. Inter-Company Accounting Record and reconcile transactions and balances between group entities, and ensure that expenses and income are booked in the correct entity with appropriate documentation. 
 B. Administration Support Office Administration Support day-to-day office administration, including office coordination, upkeep, stationery and consumables, courier management, and internal operational support. Procurement & Vendor Coordination Assist in procurement by collecting quotations, preparing comparative statements, and raising purchase orders. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for supplies, renewals, and office support requirements. Administrative Documentation Maintain organised records for contracts, agreements, rental and utility documents, insurance, vendor files, approvals, and office records. Internal Coordination Work closely with programme, HR, finance, and leadership teams to support office processes and ensure smooth cross-functional coordination. Reporting & Updates Prepare periodic accounts and administrative updates, summary sheets, and internal reports for review by the reporting manager. Additional Project Responsibilities Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Administration / Finance Manager or Senior Leadership in alignment with organisational priorities and operational needs, including assignments for Primarch Skills and its sister concerns and subsidiaries. 
 Skills Accounting & Bookkeeping: Sound understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and voucher accounting. Tally Proficiency: Ability to record transactions, maintain ledgers and cost centres, and generate reports in Tally Prime. Billing & Receivables: Ability to prepare accurate GST invoices, maintain billing registers, and follow up on collections. Statutory Compliance: Working knowledge of GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and Professional Tax processes and due dates. Reconciliation: Ability to reconcile bank accounts, vendor and customer ledgers, and GST and TDS records. MS Excel & Office Tools: Proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivot tables, SUMIFS), Word, PowerPoint, email, and file management. Administration Support: Ability to manage office coordination, procurement, and vendor follow-ups efficiently. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills for professional follow-up and internal coordination. Confidentiality & Professionalism: Ability to handle financial and administrative information with discretion and integrity. 
 Competencies Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and ensures timely completion. Accuracy & Attention to Detail: Maintains precision in entries, calculations, and statutory filings. Analytical Thinking: Able to review records, identify discrepancies, and maintain accuracy in documentation. Deadline Discipline: Consistently meets statutory due dates and month-end timelines. Problem Solving: Can address operational and accounting issues, follow up effectively, and support resolution of bottlenecks. Collaboration & Teamwork: Works effectively with finance, administration, HR, and programme teams. Process Orientation: Strong commitment to structured workflows, compliance, and record management. Professional Conduct: Maintains confidentiality, discipline, and a service-oriented attitude. 
 Tools & Technical Proficiency Mandatory Tally Prime / Tally ERP 9. MS Excel. MS Word. MS PowerPoint. GST portal and Income Tax / TRACES portal. Email and calendar tools. File and documentation systems. Desired EPFO and ESIC employer portals. Net banking and bulk payment platforms. Google Sheets. Invoice, expense, and payment management tools. Document management systems. Basic reporting and dashboard tools. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, organised, and proactive, with a strong interest in accounts and finance operations and a working understanding of office administration. Candidates with hands-on Tally experience and exposure to GST and TDS compliance will be strongly preferred, as will candidates with experience in skilling, development, education, or other project-driven organisations. Preference will also be given to candidates who demonstrate maturity, confidentiality, ownership, and the ability to manage accounting and administrative tasks in a structured, deadline-driven environment. 
 Travel & Mobility Requirements Primarily office-based role in Mumbai. Occasional travel may be required for banking, vendor coordination, document submission, or operational support. Flexibility to support off-site administrative or finance-related tasks when needed. 
 What You Gain From This Role This role offers the opportunity to build a strong foundation in accounts and finance operations within a mission-driven organisation working on large-scale livelihood and skilling initiatives. The selected candidate will gain hands-on exposure to bookkeeping, billing, statutory compliance, audits, project costing, and office administration in a high-impact environment. The role provides a strong platform for growth in accounting, finance operations, and organisational support functions. 
 Diversity, Equality & Inclusion Primarch Skills Pvt. Ltd. is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We encourage applications from candidates across different social, cultural, educational, and professional backgrounds. We believe diversity strengthens problem-solving, innovation, and impact, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity and fair treatment throughout the recruitment and employment process. 
 Background Verification & Integrity Checks Selected candidates may undergo background verification and reference checks through relevant authorities or authorised agencies. Candidates applying for this role should: Provide accurate educational and professional information. Be willing to submit documents required for verification processes, if requested. Demonstrate professional integrity, accountability, and a strong commitment to ethical conduct.

title: Distribution Centre Manager
description:
Role Overview 
Devyani International Limited is seeking an experienced Manager Distribution Centre (DC) to lead a multi-temperature DC, supplying frozen, chilled, and ambient products to its QSR restaurant network.
The role is accountable for efficient DC operations, cold chain integrity, inventory accuracy, dispatch accuracy, logistics management, and transporter and 3PL performance, with full compliance to food safety, quality, and statutory standards. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. DC Operations 
 Lead end-to-end DC operations across frozen, chilled, and ambient zones, from receiving and put-away to picking and dispatch. Plan daily operations in line with restaurant order cycles, delivery schedules, and cut-off times. Plan storage and handling capacities for regular volumes, seasonal peaks, promotions, and new restaurant openings. Establish and enforce SOPs and ensure DC infrastructure and equipment are safe and well maintained. 
 2. Cold Chain Management 
 Ensure prescribed temperatures are maintained across storage areas, docks, and delivery vehicles. Monitor temperature records and manage excursions through timely escalation, product hold, and disposition with QA. Coordinate preventive maintenance of refrigeration systems and power backup. 3. Inventory Control 
 Maintain high inventory accuracy through cycle counts, physical verification, and timely reconciliation. Enforce FEFO/FIFO, batch, and shelf-life management for all supplies to restaurants. Control damages, near-expiry stock, and write-offs, and resolve inventory variances. 
 4. Dispatch Accuracy & Restaurant Service 
 Ensure accurate, on-time, in-full (OTIF) fulfilment of restaurant orders. Drive dispatch accuracy through robust picking, checking, and loading controls. Resolve restaurant complaints and manage returns through root cause analysis and corrective action. 
 5. Logistics, Transporter & 3PL Management 
 Plan delivery routes and vehicle placement to meet delivery windows at optimum cost. Ensure vehicles, especially reefers, meet temperature, hygiene, and documentation standards. Manage transporter and 3PL performance against SLAs through periodic reviews and scorecards. Validate logistics invoices and drive improvements in cost per case and vehicle utilization. 
 6. Food Safety, Quality & Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with FSSAI, food safety management systems, and brand quality standards. Maintain hygiene, sanitation, pest control, and product traceability. Lead internal, brand, and statutory audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions. Ensure statutory, fire safety, and workplace safety compliance at the DC. 
 7. People, Cost & Performance 
 Lead and develop the DC team, including 3PL and contract workforce. Manage the DC operating budget and drive cost efficiency. Publish KPI dashboards and drive continuous improvement and WMS/ERP adoption. 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Dispatch Accuracy OTIF Delivery to Restaurants Inventory Accuracy Cold Chain / Temperature Compliance Damage, Wastage & Expiry Write-offs Transporter & 3PL SLA Adherence Logistics & DC Cost per Case Food Safety & Audit Scores Safety Incidents Candidate Profile
 Education: 
 Graduate in any discipline; qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations preferred. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain or Operations will be an added advantage. 
 Experience: 
 8 -12 years in warehousing and distribution, including 3-4 years managing a multi-temperature DC. Experience in QSR, food service, FMCG, or frozen foods preferred. Proven experience in managing transporters and 3PL partners. Working knowledge of WMS/ERP systems and FSSAI requirements. 
 Key Skills 
 DC & Warehouse Operations Cold Chain Management Inventory Control & FEFO/FIFO Dispatch Accuracy & OTIF Transportation Management 3PL & Transporter Management Food Safety & Compliance SAP/WMS/ERP/TMS Cost Management & MIS People Leadership Preferred Candidate Attributes
 Strong, hands-on operational leadership. Sound understanding of multi-temperature supply chains. High focus on accuracy, service, and restaurant satisfaction. Ability to perform in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Uncompromising commitment to food safety, quality, and compliance.

 About DP World Global Service Centre DP World’s Global Service Centre (GSCs) are key enablers of growth delivering standardization, process excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services, Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World’s growth and business transformation. As an equal employer that recognizes and values diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade. 
 Role Purpose Lead the end-to-end design and transition of work from regions into the GSC, shaping sustainable delivery solutions from target operating model, organization and team structure, capacity and skill requirements, governance and controls through knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live and stabilization. Independently partner with regional and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and ensure controlled, transparent and successful transitions.
 
 Designation: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre Department – Business Process Base Location: Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai Reporting To: Vice President 
 Key Role Responsibilities Collaborate independently with regional stakeholders and GSC functional owners to understand business objectives, process scope, pain points, volumes, service expectations, controls and dependencies. Design end-to-end GSC / offshoring solutions, including target operating model, team structure, spans and layers, capacity, skill mix, governance and charge back. Translate the agreed solution into detailed process scope, resource requirements, implementation approach, dependencies, assumptions, service levels, controls and measurable business outcomes. Apply strong knowledge of GSC, shared services and offshoring models, transition methodologies, process design, operational controls and industry best practices to develop practical and scalable solutions. Act as a trusted advisor and primary transition / solutioning partner to senior regional and functional stakeholders, independently leading discussions, workshops, negotiations and decision-making forums. Communicate solution options, trade-offs, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; constructively challenge assumptions where required to protect transition and operational outcomes. Collaborate with GSC leadership, operations, process owners, HR, finance, technology, Process Excellence and other enabling functions to validate solution feasibility and ensure end-to-end implementation readiness. Define clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights and governance across regional and GSC teams throughout solution design, transition and stabilization. Prepare and maintain comprehensive solution and transition documentation, including scope and process maps, target operating model, organization design, resource and capacity plans, RACI, assumptions, dependencies, business case inputs, implementation plans and governance packs. Own end-to-end transitions of process scope from regions into the GSC, from initiation and due diligence through planning, knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live, stabilization and formal handover to operations. Define transition objectives, in-scope / out-of-scope activities, success measures, milestones, deliverables and acceptance criteria jointly with stakeholders and receiving operations teams. Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering resourcing, hiring and onboarding, knowledge transfer, training, access and technology readiness, controls, documentation, communications and operational readiness. Establish and govern structured transition toll gates with clear entry / exit criteria and evidence-based readiness assessments; ensure appropriate stakeholder sign-offs before progression and go-live. Maintain robust RAID management, proactively identifying risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies; define mitigants, owners and escalation paths and drive timely resolution of roadblocks. Lead transition governance and stakeholder reporting, tracking milestones, actions, decisions, readiness and overall transition health; escalate material risks or deviations with clear recommendations and recovery plans. Manage go-live and stabilization / hypercare, monitor agreed service and quality indicators, close residual risks and actions, capture lessons learned and complete a structured handover to business-as-usual operations. 
 Skills & Competencies Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with significant hands-on experience in transition management, solutioning, shared services / GSC, BPO or offshoring environments. Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional transitions is essential. Strong knowledge of transition and solutioning frameworks, target operating model and organization design, capacity / resource planning, governance, toll-gate methodology, risk management, process migration and operational readiness. Strong analytical, structured problem-solving and commercial mindset, with the ability to convert ambiguous requirements into executable solutions and transition plans. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with confidence engaging independently with senior leaders across regions and functions. Strong project and program management capability, including governance, milestone management, RAID management, executive reporting and management of multiple concurrent transitions. Demonstrated ownership, judgement and decision-making ability; comfortable challenging constructively, managing competing priorities and driving outcomes in a matrixed, multicultural environment. Strong change leadership and knowledge-transfer capability, with a focus on business continuity, control effectiveness, service quality and sustainable adoption. Ability to work autonomously, travel as required for transition activity, and manage stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 Education & Qualifications Minimum bachelor's degree in Business Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree and/or recognized project, transition or change management certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus. . DP World is committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief.

title: Pest Control Technician
description:
Pest Control Technician Department Operations / Field Services Reporting To Field Supervisor / Operations Manager Job Purpose The Pest Control Technician is responsible for carrying out pest control services at customer locations safely, professionally, and according to company procedures. The technician must follow daily briefings, safety instructions, chemical handling procedures, and customer-service standards. Daily Responsibilities 1. Report to Office 8:00 AM Report to the office every working day by 8:00 AM sharp . Mark attendance and be ready for the daily briefing. Check the assigned work schedule and customer locations. Ensure all required equipment, chemicals, PPE, and tools are available before leaving for the field. 2. Morning Briefing Attend the daily briefing conducted by the supervisor. Understand the day's assigned jobs, locations, and work priorities. Read and understand all safety instructions and precautions applicable to the day's work. Take note of any special instructions related to chemicals, equipment, customer premises, pets, children, food areas, electrical equipment, or other hazards. Clarify any doubts with the supervisor before leaving for the field. 3. Prepare for Field Work Before leaving the office, ensure that: Required pest-control chemicals are available and properly labelled. Sprayers, bait stations, traps, machines, and other equipment are in working condition. Required PPE such as gloves, mask/respirator, safety shoes, goggles, and protective clothing is available and used as required. Customer/job details and instructions are properly understood. The vehicle/bike and equipment are safely arranged for transportation. 4. Travel to Customer Location Reach the assigned customer location on time. Follow the planned route and maintain professional behaviour during travel. Handle chemicals and equipment safely while travelling. 5. Carry Out Pest Control Work Inspect the site and identify pest activity and possible sources of infestation. Explain the treatment process to the customer when required. Carry out pest-control treatment according to company procedures and the instructions provided during training. Use only the approved chemical, quantity, equipment, and application method for the assigned treatment. Follow all label instructions and safety requirements. Protect food, utensils, electrical equipment, furniture, pets, children, and other sensitive areas as required. Do not mix or use chemicals in an unauthorised manner. Maintain cleanliness and avoid unnecessary damage to the customer's property. Inform the supervisor immediately if any unusual hazard, infestation, customer concern, chemical issue, or equipment problem is identified. 6. Customer Service Maintain polite, respectful, and professional communication with customers. Explain basic precautions that the customer needs to follow after treatment. Answer customer questions within the scope of the technician's training. Escalate complaints or technical issues to the supervisor. 7. Job Completion & Documentation After completing each job: Confirm that the treatment has been completed properly. Clean and safely pack all equipment and materials. Complete the required service report/job sheet. Record chemicals and materials used, where required. Obtain customer confirmation/signature or digital completion acknowledgement, as applicable. Report any follow-up requirement to the supervisor. 8. End-of-Day Responsibilities Return to the office or designated location as instructed. Return unused chemicals, equipment, and company property safely. Report damaged, missing, or malfunctioning equipment. Submit completed job sheets/reports. Inform the supervisor about pending jobs, customer complaints, repeat treatments, or follow-ups. Maintain the vehicle, equipment, and work area in a clean and organised condition. Safety Responsibilities Always follow company safety procedures and chemical labels. Wear the required PPE during treatment and chemical handling. Never eat, drink, smoke, or engage in unsafe activities while handling chemicals. Store and transport chemicals safely. Report any spill, exposure, accident, injury, or unsafe condition immediately. title: Actuarial Associate Manager
description:
The Role The Actuarial Associate Manager is responsibility to manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial projects across reserving, pricing, capital, risk modelling and financial reporting. The role combines hands-on actuarial expertise with technical review, project management, client engagement and day-to-day guidance of a small team or project workstream. You will apply sound actuarial judgement to data, methods, assumptions, models and conclusions; ensure high-quality and timely delivery; explain findings clearly to clients and senior colleagues; and build team capability through coaching, feedback and knowledge sharing. What You Will Do Actuarial Project Delivery Manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial assignments across P&C reserving, pricing and insurance optimisation, captive capital and Solvency II, risk financing, and financial reporting. Define and manage scope, workplans, timelines, budgets, dependencies and quality checkpoints for small to medium projects or workstreams within larger engagements. Prepare and oversee forward-looking loss forecasts, reserve analyses, capital assessments and other bespoke actuarial models for corporate and captive insurance clients. Interpret model outputs, investigate movements and translate technical results into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Technical Review and Quality Assurance Perform independent technical and editorial review of data, methodologies, assumptions, calculations, models and client deliverables, applying reasonableness checks and actuarial judgement. Ensure work is accurate, reproducible, appropriately documented and compliant with applicable professional, regulatory and internal standards. Resolve routine and moderately complex technical issues using established methods and prior experience, escalating novel or higher-risk matters when appropriate. Maintain clear review evidence and support continuous improvement of templates, controls and quality frameworks. Lead or contribute substantively to client calls, meetings, workshops and presentations, explaining actuarial methods, findings, limitations and recommendations in accessible language. Work collaboratively with colleagues across geographies and disciplines, coordinating inputs and ensuring effective information exchange. Team Leadership and Capability Building Coordinate the daily activities of analysts and senior analysts on assigned engagements, allocate work and monitor progress against agreed plans. Coach colleagues, answer technical queries and provide timely, constructive feedback that improves actuarial judgement, communication and delivery quality. Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to a cooperative, inclusive environment that encourages technical development and shared learning. Support resource planning, workload prioritisation, onboarding and development discussions for the immediate team. Core Areas of Work Area / Typical responsibilities P&C Pricing and Optimisation - Loss forecasting, insurance programme analysis, risk transfer optimisation and strategic recommendations. P&C Reserving - Reserving analysis, movement investigation, methods and assumptions, report writing and clear presentation of conclusions. Capital and Solvency II - Profitability and financial strength assessment for captives, review of SCR and technical provisions, assumption challenge and regulatory support. Bespoke Analytics -Risk financing, modelling tools, scenario analysis, automation, research and multidisciplinary risk projects. Experience and Qualifications Recognised degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering or another highly numerate discipline. A minimum of 8 out of 13 actuarial examinations completed toward a recognised actuarial qualification. At least 5 years of relevant actuarial experience, including experience in one or more of P&C reserving, pricing, capital, risk financing, captive insurance or financial reporting. Experience managing project delivery or workstreams, reviewing actuarial work and guiding junior colleagues. Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise reports and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Technical Tools Strong Microsoft Office capability is required. Proficiency in at least one relevant analytical or actuarial tool is expected, such as R/R Shiny, Python, Power BI, RADAR, Igloo or ResQ. The successful candidate should be able to select fit-for-purpose tools, review outputs critically and support reproducible analysis. This description outlines the principal responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, client demand and the development of the successful candidate.

title: Operation Manager - PG & Serviced Apartments
description:
FARGO HOMES is looking for a responsible, proactive and hands-on Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operations of our PG/hostel and serviced-apartment properties. The role will involve overseeing approximately 250 PG/hostel beds , along with serviced apartments, residents, guests, staff, vendors and property maintenance. 
 This is a field-oriented, hands-on operations role . The ideal candidate should be comfortable visiting properties, interacting with residents and guests, coordinating staff and vendors, inspecting properties and personally following up until operational issues are resolved. 
 The Operations Manager will report directly to the Owner/Management and will act as the primary day-to-day operational point of contact for the business. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. PG / Hostel Operations Manage day-to-day operations of approximately 250 PG/hostel beds. Monitor occupancy, vacancies, admissions, renewals and move-outs. Coordinate resident onboarding and check-out processes. Coordinate Leave & Licence agreements, KYC/documentation and police verification. Maintain accurate and updated resident records. Handle resident queries, complaints and routine operational issues. Conduct regular property inspections. Ensure cleanliness, hygiene and overall property upkeep. Coordinate housekeeping, repairs and maintenance activities. Monitor staff attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure residents and employees follow company rules and operating procedures. 2. Serviced Apartment Operations Manage daily operations of serviced apartments. Coordinate guest check-ins and check-outs. Ensure rooms/properties are guest-ready before every arrival. Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance and linen requirements. Handle routine guest queries and complaints. Communicate with guests through telephone, WhatsApp and other channels. Monitor guest feedback and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain required standards of cleanliness, presentation and service. 3. Reservations & Enquiry Coordination Monitor PG and serviced-apartment enquiries received through various channels. Ensure timely responses to telephone, WhatsApp and online enquiries. Coordinate with the reservations/customer-service team. Follow up with prospective residents and guests. Monitor enquiry-to-booking/admission conversions. Maintain an updated enquiry and follow-up database. Escalate pricing and other commercial decisions to management when required. 4. Staff Management Allocate daily responsibilities to operational staff. Monitor attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure assigned tasks are completed on time. Train and guide employees whenever required. Prepare staff duty schedules. Address routine performance and discipline issues. Maintain professional conduct and accountability within the team. 5. Vendor & Maintenance Management Coordinate with plumbers, electricians, carpenters, AC technicians, pest-control agencies, housekeeping vendors and other service providers. Obtain quotations where required. Assign and track maintenance requests. Verify completion and quality of work before closing maintenance requests. Maintain records of pending and completed maintenance. Monitor recurring maintenance problems and identify corrective action. Escalate major repairs/expenditure to management for approval. Ensure vendors submit proper bills/invoices. 6. Rent & Collection Coordination Monitor PG rent due dates. Follow up on outstanding payments. Maintain an updated rent-outstanding report. Coordinate with the Accounts/Admin team. Escalate persistent payment defaults to management. Ensure move-in and move-out financial formalities are completed. The Operations Manager will coordinate collections and follow-ups but will not independently waive, reduce or settle financial dues without management approval. 
 7. Property Quality Control Conduct regular inspections covering: Cleanliness and hygiene Bedrooms and bathrooms Furniture and fixtures Electrical equipment Air conditioners Plumbing and water supply Wi-Fi Kitchen and common areas Safety equipment Overall property condition All deficiencies should be documented, assigned to the responsible person/vendor and followed up until closure. 
 8. Daily Operations Reporting Submit a concise daily operational report covering: Total occupancy Vacant beds New enquiries Property visits Admissions Move-outs Rent outstanding Maintenance complaints Maintenance completed Serviced-apartment bookings Guest complaints Staff attendance Important issues requiring management attention 9. Management Escalation The Operations Manager is expected to independently resolve routine operational matters within company policies and approved limits. The following should be escalated promptly to management: Major resident or guest disputes Significant financial claims Legal notices or disputes Major repairs or expenditure Unusual refunds or compensation requests Security incidents Police matters Vendor disputes Serious employee misconduct Major property damage Authority & Accountability The Operations Manager will be responsible for the smooth functioning of day-to-day operations across the properties. The position will have authority to: Coordinate employees and vendors. Allocate operational responsibilities. Resolve routine resident/guest issues. Follow up on maintenance and service requests. Take routine operational decisions within company policies and approved expenditure limits. The Operations Manager will report directly to the Owner/Management . The key objective of this role is to reduce the management's involvement in routine operational matters and ensure that issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Performance will be evaluated based on: Smooth day-to-day functioning of all properties. Timely resolution of resident and guest complaints. Property cleanliness, upkeep and maintenance standards. Staff attendance, discipline and productivity. Timely completion of maintenance work. Reduction in recurring operational complaints. Accuracy of occupancy and resident records. Timely rent follow-up and reporting. Response time to operational issues. Accuracy and timeliness of daily/weekly reports. Resident and guest satisfaction. Ability to independently resolve routine issues without unnecessary management escalation. Desired Profile: We are looking for someone who is: Responsible and honest. Proactive and well organised. Calm under pressure. Solution-oriented. Punctual and dependable. Comfortable taking ownership. Professional in communication. Capable of making sensible decisions independently. Comfortable managing multiple properties and priorities. Willing to work in a hands-on, field-oriented environment. Required Qualifications & Experience: Graduate in any discipline, BHM is highly Preferred. 3+ years of relevant experience in PG, hostel, co-living, serviced apartments, hotels, property management or related operations. Experience managing residential/guest properties and operational teams will be preferred. Key Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good spoken and written English. Hindi is essential. Marathi will be an advantage. Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets . Comfortable using WhatsApp, email and smartphone applications. Strong organisational and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple properties, staff and tasks. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Staff and vendor management. Customer-service orientation. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Mature and responsible approach to handling residents, guests and confidential business information. Important Requirement:

Skill required: Talent Development - Learning Delivery Operations

 Qualifications: Any Graduation
