 What would you do 
 Deliver high-impact virtual leadership and communication training for employees of a US-based logistics company. This is a delivery-focused learning partner role, not an end-to-end course builder. The ideal candidate will:
 Conceptualize the right delivery approach for leadership and non-technical topics
 Advise on program structure and flow to maximize participant impact
 Engage confidently with senior client audiences while collaborating with the central design team
 Conduct comprehensive needs analysis and drive continuous improvement measurement
 Maintain strong customer relationships and demonstrate expertise through recognized LDP certifications
This role emphasizes world-class virtual delivery, customer partnership, and data-driven improvementleveraging pre-built curriculum and design support from the central team.
Talent Development involves creating and implementing programs to enhance employees skills and career growth. This includes training, mentoring, and performance management. The goal is to help employees reach their full potential and contribute effectively to the organization. Responsibilities also include identifying skill gaps and developing strategies to address them. This role is essential for fostering a skilled and motivated workforce.
Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability.

 What are we looking for 
 5-10 years of proven experience delivering leadership and communication training, preferably with US client exposure and scalable virtual delivery models.
 Minimum ONE recognized LDP certification (MBTI-trained facilitator, Hogan certified, DDI trained, CliftonStrengths certified, Five Behaviors facilitator, or equivalent industry-standard credential demonstrating specialized expertise).
 Demonstrated experience conducting needs analysis for training programs, including learner personas, organizational context assessment, and success metric definition.
 Multiple LDP certifications (e.g., MBTI + Hogan + CliftonStrengths combination) demonstrating depth of expertise.
 Experience with logistics-specific leadership challenges, frontline team motivation, operational decision-making, and supply chain context.
 Expertise in adaptive, blended, and personalized learning models; experience with learning technology and adaptive platforms.
 Track record of scaling training programs from pilot to enterprise level; experience managing multiple concurrent cohorts.
 Speaking experience at industry conferences, webinars, or training forums.
 Background in organizational development, change management, or executive coaching.

Essential Skills Competencies
1. Needs Analysis Discovery - Ability to conduct structured interviews, design assessment frameworks, analyze organizational contexts, and translate insights into delivery design.
2. Persona Development Adaptation - Skill in creating learner personas, adapting communication style, and customizing examples and activities based on audience profiles.
3. Measurement Data Analysis - Comfort with training metrics, survey design, data interpretation, and translating findings into recommendations.
4. Continuous Improvement Mindset - Proactive approach to identifying enhancement opportunities, iterating on delivery, and documenting learnings for scaling.
5. Customer Liaison Stakeholder Management - Comfort presenting to C-suite, gathering feedback, managing expectations, and building collaborative partnerships.
6. Virtual Facilitation Excellence - Mastery of virtual delivery techniques, participant engagement in distributed settings, time zone flexibility, and technical proficiency.
7. LDP Framework Expertise - Deep knowledge of behavioral, personality, or emotional intelligence assessment models; ability to integrate frameworks into training design and coaching. 

 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 Training Delivery Content Customization Conduct engaging, interactive virtual sessions on leadership and communication skills tailored for US logistics professionals (frontline supervisors to senior leaders). Perform comprehensive pre-training needs analysis within 2 weeks of engagement kickoff to identify skill gaps, learner personas, organizational context, and delivery readiness. Customize training delivery and examples to address core logistics leadership topics: team collaboration, communication, problem-solving, technology adaptability, resilience in operational disruptions. Cover relevant leadership skills from industry-recognized Leadership Development Programs (LDPs): self-awareness, team performance acceleration, effective feedback, resilience, trust-building, leading with authenticity in complex environments. Leverage Training-as-a-Service (TaaS) principles for scalable, interactive virtual training aligned with US business hours and operational realities.Persona-Based Delivery Adaptation Conduct participant persona analysis (frontline supervisors, middle managers, senior leaders) to understand diverse learning needs, communication preferences, operational challenges, and success drivers. Adapt delivery style, examples, case studies, and facilitation methods based on persona-specific requirements and organizational culture. Tailor pace, interaction methods, and breakout room activities to match learner profiles (e.g., high-pressure operational leaders vs. strategic planning roles). Provide persona-specific feedback and coaching to ensure relevance and on-the-job application for participant roles.LDP Expertise Professional Mastery Demonstrate mastery of at least one recognized Leadership Development Program framework (Hogan, DDI, CliftonStrengths, MBTI, Five Behaviors of a Cohesive Team, or equivalent). Apply personality, behavioral, and emotional intelligence assessment frameworks to training design and participant coaching. Integrate LDP frameworks into 100% of training modules as a performance expectation.

title: General Manager Project Operations Infrastructure
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Position: DGM / General Manager Project Operations (Infrastructure)
 Location: HO Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai
 Industry: Infrastructure EPC
 Employment Type: Full Time
 Experience: 1520 Years
 Role Purpose The DGM / General Manager Project Operations will provide strategic and operational leadership for the end-to-end execution of large-scale Electrical and Infrastructure EPC projects , with strong exposure to Power Transmission & Distribution, Metro/Railways, Renewable Energy and other infrastructure projects . 
 The role will be responsible for ensuring project delivery, schedule adherence, cost control, quality, safety, contractual compliance and profitability , while leading multiple project teams and driving operational excellence. 
 Key Sectors / Project Exposure Power Transmission & Distribution: Substations, Transmission Lines, Distribution Networks Railways & Metro: Railway Electrification and Metro Infrastructure Projects Renewable Energy: Solar and Hybrid Projects Water & Wastewater: Treatment Plants, Pumping Stations and Pipelines Energy Storage: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Infrastructure EPC / Turnkey / LSTK Projects 
 Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end execution and delivery of large-scale Infrastructure EPC / Turnkey / LSTK projects. Provide strategic leadership for multiple projects simultaneously , ensuring achievement of project objectives. Oversee project planning, execution, monitoring, commissioning and final handover. Ensure adherence to contractual scope, approved schedules, budgets, quality standards and profitability targets. Lead execution of Power T&D projects , including substations, transmission lines and distribution networks. Provide operational leadership for Metro/Railway infrastructure projects , coordinating with clients, consultants, JV partners and statutory authorities. Lead Project Managers, Construction, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, Commercial and other project functions. Drive manpower planning, resource allocation, equipment deployment and subcontractor management. Monitor project progress, productivity, cost, margins, cash flow, billing and collections. Review project performance through periodic MIS, dashboards and management review meetings. Identify project risks, bottlenecks and deviations and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Support contract administration, variation orders, claims, commercial negotiations and dispute resolution. Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, statutory approvals, HSE norms, quality systems and applicable industry standards. Act as the senior management interface with key clients, consultants, government authorities, JV partners and other stakeholders. Lead project review meetings, progress presentations and critical issue/escalation management. Drive client satisfaction, successful project completion and opportunities for repeat business. Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites and ensure zero-tolerance towards major HSE violations. Ensure effective implementation of QA/QC systems, audits, inspections and quality improvement initiatives. Provide regular project performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management. Support pre-bid reviews, technical evaluation, project feasibility, execution strategy and resource planning . Drive operational excellence, standardisation, process improvement and lessons-learned initiatives. 
 Education BE / BTech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering Post-Graduation / MBA in Project Management will be an added advantage. 
 Experience 1520 years of overall experience in Infrastructure / EPC project execution. Strong experience in Power Transmission & Distribution projects . Proven exposure to Metro / Railway infrastructure projects . Experience in Renewable Energy, Solar, Water & Wastewater and BESS projects will be an added advantage. Demonstrated experience in managing multiple large-scale, high-value EPC projects . Experience in an HO-based Project Operations / Business Operations leadership role is preferred. Candidates should have strong experience in managing large project teams and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 Technical & Leadership Competencies Strong understanding of EPC, Turnkey and LSTK project execution . Strong knowledge of project planning, project controls, cost management and resource planning. Strong understanding of contracts, claims, variations and commercial aspects of EPC projects. Excellent leadership, people management and stakeholder management skills. Strong decision-making, negotiation and problem-solving abilities. Knowledge of statutory approvals, HSE requirements, quality systems, codes and industry standards. Strong analytical ability with experience in MIS, project dashboards and performance reviews . Ability to manage project risks, escalations and critical delivery situations. 
 Preferred Background Candidates from reputed Infrastructure EPC / Engineering & Construction companies . Experience handling high-value and complex infrastructure projects . Proven track record of successful project delivery, profitability and client management. Exposure to HO-based operational leadership and strategic project management . Candidates with strong experience across Power T&D and Metro/Railway projects will be preferred. 
 Key Performance Areas Project delivery within approved time, cost, quality and safety parameters Project profitability and cost optimisation Cash flow, billing and collection performance Client satisfaction and stakeholder management Resource and subcontractor productivity HSE and quality compliance Risk mitigation and timely resolution of project issues Successful commissioning and handover Operational excellence and continuous improvement
